ex.t: "生态设计"是约翰对他所做工作的命名。

ex.s: What she proposed didn’t seem as exciting as the original project I had applied to, but I was going to give it my all.
ex.t: 她提出的方案看起来不如我最初申请的那个项目令人兴奋，但我决定全力以赴。

ex.s: I actually wanted to drop the class at one point, but stopped short because I didn't want to give him the satisfaction of my chickening out.
ex.t: 我一度想退出这门课，但没有那样做，因为我不想让他得逞以为我胆怯了。

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 专家说赞扬的质量比数量更重要。

ex.s: “Part of being a good thinker is experiencing things that are seemingly unrelated to what you are working on at the moment but give you fresh ideas about your work,” he says.
ex.t: "成为一个好的思考者的部分体验是那些看似与你当前工作无关但能给你的工作带来新灵感的事情，"他说。

defs.def: an exchange of words or ideas 交谈；思想交流

ex.s: Giving employees the tools enables them to communicate honestly
ex.t: 给员工工具使他们能够坦诚交流

ex.s: I once wrote a paper on the influence of fairy tales on Roald Dahl's writing and it gave me a new appreciation for his strange and delightful words.
ex.t: 我曾经写过一篇关于童话故事对罗尔德·达尔写作影响的论文，这让我对他奇特而美妙的文字有了新的欣赏。

ex.s: Directions: Translate the following sentences into English，using the words given in the brackets.
ex.t: 说明：将以下句子翻译成英语，使用括号中给出的词。

ex.s: Directions: Write an English composition in 120-150 words according to the instructions given below in Chinese.
ex.t: 说明：根据下面的要求，写一篇120-150词的英语作文。
